title: IRRS Declaration
description: Declaration document supplied to irrs-eval. Describes the inputs, regional prerequisite, and authorized mappings for a problem space. irrs-eval reads this file; no domain-specific Rust code is required.

topology_id.description: Topology identifier matching the one declared in the relational gate, e.g. 'circadian_v1'.

version.description: Semantic version of the application declaring this topology.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the problem space.

inputs.description: Every input value involved in the declared problem space. Includes values submitted to the gate AND values the gate produces.

mappings.description: Every authorized mapping that may be applied by the gate.

InputDeclaration.description: Declaration of a single input value in the problem space.

name.description: Short identifier matching the name used in mapping descriptions.

source_identity.description: Identity of the system, sensor, configuration file, or process that provides or generates this value.

acquisition_method.description: How this value is acquired or generated.

transformation_history.description: Sequence of transformations applied before this value reaches the gate, if any.

relationship_to_problem.description: Plain-language statement of how this value relates to the declared problem space.

supporting_evidence.description: References to evidence supporting the provenance claim. May be empty.

known_limitations.description: Known limitations, gaps, or unresolved conditions in the provenance.

submitted_to_gate.description: True when this value is submitted by the Generator in its DeclarationPackage. False for values the gate produces.

InputClassification.description: Classification describing the observational basis of an input. Describes provenance; does not determine whether an operator can execute.

enumDescriptions.primary_observable: An input supported by an identified observational acquisition process.
enumDescriptions.declared_parameter: A value supplied as a declared configuration or reference.
enumDescriptions.derived_value: A value produced through an identified transformation. The gate produces this; the Generator does not submit it.
enumDescriptions.simulated_input: A value generated within a declared simulation or test fixture.
enumDescriptions.abstract_input: A conceptual or stipulated value without a demonstrated observational basis.

ProvenanceStatus.description: Claim about the degree of independent support for a provenance assertion.

enumDescriptions.declared: The source and history asserted by the submitting party. Not independently verified.
enumDescriptions.verified: The portion of the history supported by evidence actually evaluated. Requires non-empty supporting_evidence.
enumDescriptions.unverified: The claim could not be independently verified.

EvidenceRef.description: A reference to external evidence supporting a provenance claim.

id.description: Short identifier for this evidence, e.g. 'cal-2024-03'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this evidence is and how it supports the claim.

RegionalPrerequisiteDecl.description: The four required fields of the Regional M prerequisite. No defaults: every field must be explicitly supplied.

region_name.description: Region name matching the topology ID declared in the gate.

extents_lower.description: Lower bound of the observable extent (exclusive).

extents_upper.description: Upper bound of the observable extent (exclusive).

extents_label.description: Label for the extent unit, e.g. 'phase_fraction'.

orientation_preserved.description: What the authorized mapping preserves across the family boundary.

admission_rule_name.description: Short identifier for the regional admission rule.

admission_rule_description.description: Plain-language description of the admission rule.

interior_locus_verified.description: True when the domain builder has called establish(locus) with a verified interior point.

name.description: Name matching the AuthorizedMapping registered in the gate.

input_description.description: Description of the inputs this mapping receives.

output_description.description: Description of the value this mapping produces.

preserves.description: What relational structure is preserved across the mapping.
